messages:
maria: Kicking off bring-up for AcmeCorp dedicated pool tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quota confirmation + autoscale thresholds. @jordan @sachin can you confirm?

jordan: On quota — finance showed a committed allocation. Tentative: 60k RPS allocation, reserved pool = 18 GPUs. Recommend starting autoscale at 60% utilization to allow headroom. Will confirm final number by EOD. :+1:

sachin: For autoscale I'd suggest: min_replicas=2, max_replicas=20, target_cpu=65%, target_queue=200. Also enable prefix/KV cache priming before traffic shift and use quant profile q4_2 for the model family to reduce GPU mem.

lee: Ops plan: run a 30m soak + 3 spike bursts (1m/5m/15m) after warmup. Load script is in the sim repo: https://git.internal/redwood/sim/acme-warmup

lee: Test command (staging dry-run):
```
./run_load.py --env staging --profile burst --rps 2000 --duration 1800 --warmup 300 --tag acme-prime
```

maria: Thanks. Can someone run a quick dry-run in staging tonight 23:00 PT and post logs to the thread? I'll paste the minimal runbook below:
- gate: confirm quota tag exists (ACME-RES-18)
- infra: pre-create pool and attach security group
- config: apply autoscale policy + cache priming flag
- exec: run soak, capture perf and tail-latency metrics
- rollback: switch routing to hosted-legacy if 95th latency > SLA

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 2026-03-22T09:00:00Z via cd-pipeline. Status: queued.

jordan: Confirmed with finance: final allocation = 60k RPS, reserved tag = ACME-RES-18. I've added the resource tag to the booking.

sachin: Also: enable KV cache and set quant profile to q4_2 for the 7b model. We'll watch tail-latency and tokens/sec during spikes. If token/sec drops >30% fallback to 3b variant.

lee: I'll run the soak tonight and post a short summary + logs (link). If we hit instability we'll abort and fall back to lower model size.

maria: One more note — renewal risk flagged by account exec. They want a usage-floor & cost-savings summary after 2 weeks of steady traffic. @alex_sales can you prepare an enablement deck and usage KPIs?

alex_sales: Yep, I'll take the deck. Can you share sample success metrics (e.g., avg latency, 95th, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens) so I can build slides?

maria: Great. Sync at 08:30 PT tomorrow before cutover. Agenda: who runs load, rollback owner, post-mortem owner, and executive summary for sales. 

lee: Ack. I'll be on the call and run the tests.

jordan: Will join for quota/finance Qs.

sachin: I'll monitor model perf and be ready to flip quant/model.

maria: Perfect — tagging this thread as the official run log. Post logs here after the dry-run. :rocket:
